description: MV-05 video ingest policy (libs/core/video-ingest). allowed_hosts lists the hosts (and their subdomains) a remote fetch may target; the URL host is also pre-judged by egress-policy.json. require_approval_for_remote gates every uncached remote fetch behind the risky-op approval gate. max_duration_sec / max_bytes bound what yt-dlp may download and what a local file may be; the remaining fields tune keyframe planning and the yt-dlp format selector.
